facts.fact: The Ministry of Telecommunications, Information Technologies and Social Communication (MINTTICS) put its 86-article draft Law on Artificial Intelligence on its public consultation portal in September 2025, and the draft's report says the draft was to go to public consultation open to all public and private entities and interested individuals, and that the consultation was held before the draft goes to the Council of Ministers.
facts.system: Proposta de Lei sobre a Inteligência Artificial

note: The draft's own statement that it must be put to public consultation is a rule only in the draft, so no standing-aspect fact; no published report of comments in this document.
